verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI-driven browser agents that run autonomously in managed cloud sessions, started with a single API call. That covers running autonomous tasks off the user's machine. However, each task is a one-off API-triggered run. Nothing shows recurring schedules, triggers or a way to set up persistent background automations, so the 'set up automations' part rests on the user's own orchestration. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/recurring runs, event triggers or persistent automation configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended background operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Hyperbrowser lets you run powerful, AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions.
you can start tasks with a single API call and watch them execute live
Built in support for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, and BrowserUse agents.
